THE VESSELS MUST REST. The Mekhilta's hook on this verse's take-heed arm: the RESTING OF VESSELS on Shabbat, Torah-grade even for Beit Hillel (Rav Yosef's route for the barred mill, against Rabba's noise-as-contempt — dual-track). The split that saves the nightfall licenses: a vessel that performs no action (incense coals, idle oven, hook nets) rests while its work happens; an acting trap is barred — the vessel's own physics decides.
